args.summary: Following the v2.3.1 production deploy, checkout-api began failing health checks (unhealthy, error rate ~18%). Rolled back all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east); retry succeeded, completing rollout in us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback verification: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate ~0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Rollback:**
1. Checked deployment history — `v2.3.0` was the most recent release that was healthy in production (`v2.3.1` was unhealthy).
2. First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east), leaving the fleet in a mixed state (us-west and eu-west still on broken v2.3.1, error rate ~18%).
3. Retried the rollback — succeeded. All three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on `v2.3.0`.
4. Verified: checkout-api is healthy in all regions with error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident:**
- The initial incident creation timed out, but verification via `list_incidents` confirmed it was actually created (thanks to the idempotency key, so no duplicate): **INC-0001**, SEV2, open, documenting the health-check failures, the partial rollback failure and retry, and the successful recovery on v2.3.0.
